hook_line: JAILER 2 CROSSES ₹209 CRORE IN TWO DAYS

hook_stat.sub: Worldwide gross in two days, Pinkvilla reported

news_summary: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 grossed about ₹84 crore worldwide on day two, taking its two-day worldwide total to roughly ₹209 crore, Pinkvilla reported.
payoff: Trade trackers say ₹500 crore by midweek is in play.
